"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Privatizing Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac would be a windfall to hedge funds.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
